model.name: Moss Image 5B Edit SFT
model.description: Edit an image with text instructions or combine up to four ordered references using MOSS Image SFT. Its editing adapter supports changes to clothing, backgrounds, lighting and style; reference details and composition are guidance rather than pixel-level guarantees. Optional KV caching speeds denoising at the cost of additional memory.

prompt: Change the background to a sunny beach. Preserve the person, clothing and pose.
